name: Broulim's Supermarket Fresh Deli California Roll & Steamed Rice
whyItWorks: Seasoned white sushi rice, cooked imitation crab (white fish surimi), and creamy avocado in a grab-and-go tray from Broulim's deli make a clean, non-greasy road-trip meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab a plain California Roll or Cooked Shrimp Roll from the deli case (avoid spicy mayo, tempura crunch, and cream cheese rolls).
watchOuts: Skip wasabi and spicy mayo drizzle; remove cucumber strips if strict low-residue
